What we do

Roofing services

From a single leaking tile to a full re-roof, one local crew handles the lot — no subcontractor runaround, no surprise add-ons.

Roof repairs & leak detection

A drip today is a ceiling collapse tomorrow. We trace leaks to the source — not just the stain — and fix them properly the first time.

  • Leak tracing and permanent repairs
  • Cracked tile replacement & re-bedding
  • Flashing, valley and ridge cap repairs
  • Storm damage make-safe

Roof restoration

  • All old material removed from site

Good to know

Common questions

How much does a roof inspection cost?+

Nothing. Inspections and written quotes are free, with no obligation. Call (02) 4089 4613 or send the enquiry form below and we'll arrange a time that suits you.

My roof is leaking — how fast can you come out?+

We're based in Newcastle West, so local leaks usually get a same-week visit, and urgent storm damage gets an emergency make-safe as soon as we can safely get on the roof. Call us and we'll give you an honest timeframe on the spot.

Restoration or replacement — which do I need?+

If the tile surface and structure are sound, a restoration (clean, repair, seal, coat) can add 10–15 years of life for far less than a new roof. If tiles are brittle, battens are rotted or the roof has reached the end of its life, replacement is the smarter spend. Our inspection includes photos so you can see exactly why we recommend one or the other.

Do you work on Colorbond® and metal roofs too?+

Yes — tile and metal. We repair and replace Colorbond® and other metal roofing, including rust treatment, sheet replacement, screws and flashings, and tile-to-metal conversions.
